sections.1:
This Blueprint Document outlines the foundational approach for the Kinaxis implementation at Bristelecone, a company operating within the mobile industry. The document provides a structured overview of Bristelecone’s current business environment, the objectives of the Kinaxis deployment, and the defined scope for Phase 1, which is focused on supply management. The intent is to ensure alignment among stakeholders and to establish a clear reference for the project’s execution.

The following sections detail Bristelecone’s company information, current state of business processes, the purpose of the Kinaxis implementation, the scope of the initial phase, and a glossary of key acronyms relevant to this initiative.
sections.1.1: Bristelecone is a company in the mobile industry, utilizing SAP as its core ERP system. The organization is committed to advancing its supply chain planning processes, with a particular emphasis on integrated planning and automation. Bristelecone’s business operations are characterized by a focus on supply management, and the company is undertaking a phased approach to digital transformation, beginning with the implementation of Kinaxis for supply management in Phase 1.
sections.1.2: Bristelecone’s current state of business is characterized by integrated planning processes supported by SAP ERP, with some elements of automation already in place. While these capabilities provide a foundation for effective supply management, Bristelecone recognizes the need for further enhancement to address evolving market demands and operational complexities. The organization seeks to improve visibility, responsiveness, and decision-making across its supply chain functions.
sections.1.3: The purpose of this Blueprint Document is to define the framework for implementing Kinaxis at Bristelecone, with a primary focus on supply management in Phase 1. The document aims to ensure that all stakeholders have a clear understanding of the project’s objectives, deliverables, and success criteria. By establishing a common reference point, Bristelecone seeks to drive alignment across business and technical teams, supporting a smooth and effective Kinaxis deployment.
sections.1.4: The scope of this Blueprint Document is specific to Bristelecone, a leading company in the mobile industry, leveraging SAP as its core ERP system. This document, prepared by Bristelecone in collaboration with Kinaxis, focuses exclusively on Phase 1 of the supply chain transformation initiative: Supply Management. The Blueprint outlines the processes, system integrations, and functional requirements necessary to enable integrated planning with a degree of automation, in alignment with Bristelecone’s current planning maturity. The scope encompasses all supply management activities that interface with SAP, ensuring that the solution design supports Bristelecone’s business objectives and industry best practices for mobile sector supply chains.

sections.2:
Bristelecone’s implementation of Kinaxis for supply management, integrated with SAP ERP, is expected to deliver tangible benefits aligned with the company’s strategic objectives in the mobile industry. The benefit realization approach is structured to ensure that value is delivered throughout the project lifecycle and is measurable against defined success criteria.

- Enhanced Supply Chain Visibility
  - Bristelecone will achieve real-time, end-to-end visibility across supply management processes, enabling proactive identification and resolution of supply constraints.
  - Integration with SAP will ensure data consistency and reduce manual data reconciliation efforts.
- Improved Responsiveness and Agility
  - Kinaxis will enable Bristelecone to rapidly simulate supply scenarios and assess the impact of changes, supporting faster and more informed decision-making.
  - Automated workflows will reduce cycle times for supply planning adjustments.
- Increased Planning Accuracy
  - The solution will leverage integrated planning capabilities to improve forecast accuracy and alignment between supply and demand.
  - Automated exception management will minimize planning errors and manual interventions.
- Operational Efficiency Gains
  - Bristelecone will benefit from reduced manual effort in supply management processes through automation and streamlined workflows.
  - Standardized processes will drive consistency and reduce operational risk.
- Measurable Business Outcomes
  - Key performance indicators (KPIs) will be established to track improvements in supply chain metrics such as inventory turns, order fulfillment rates, and supply plan adherence.
  - Bristelecone will conduct periodic benefit reviews to ensure alignment with business objectives and to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

The benefit realization plan will be jointly managed by Bristelecone and the implementation team, with clear ownership of benefit tracking and reporting. This approach will ensure that the Kinaxis deployment delivers sustained value and supports Bristelecone’s ongoing supply chain transformation.
